title: Clemson vs Duke: 4th Quarter Point Spread

content.value: This market resolves to Yes if Duke covers a -7.5 point spread against Clemson during the 4th quarter of the College Football game between Clemson and Duke scheduled for November 20, 2026 at 7:30 PM ET, meaning Duke scores more than 7.5 points more than Clemson during the 4th quarter. Otherwise, it resolves to No. The Underlying counts only points scored by each team during the 4th quarter, as documented by the official quarter-by-quarter scoring summary, and excludes overtime. Source Agencies, in order, are the league governing body, ESPN, Fox Sports, and the broadcast partner of the event. If the Expiration Value cannot be determined on the Expiration Date (including because the game is cancelled or a team forfeits, withdraws, or is disqualified), the Exchange may determine payouts pursuant to the Market Outcome Review Process.
